verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents column-based upserts, conditional upserts/patches/deletes, and delete-by-filter. It states that vectors are incrementally indexed in an SPFresh index so writes appear in search results immediately. Namespace metadata also exposes the count of write-ahead-log rows not yet indexed, a documented signal of index freshness. missing for 10: an explicit documented consistency model (e.g. strong vs eventual read options and their tradeoffs), quantified write-to-query latency figures, and independent or hands-on corroboration of freshness under continuous writes.
